description: Natural-language local-task-driven state-based ReAct. One controller, one working state, two model task kinds (Interpret/Choose). Model sees NL descriptive roles; program carries IDs/dependencies/sources/versions.

three_data_dependencies.question_to_task: Frame.answer_target drives the auto-created first local task; the original question is never rewritten.
three_data_dependencies.observation_to_judgment: Every judgment cites a delivered source_ref and exact quote; scoped to a task; correctable via CorrectionPatch.
three_data_dependencies.judgment_to_action: reduce() updates routing; choose(query) reaches the real search backend via harness._dispatch; choose(read_hit_dN) emits a real read.

criteria: NL target not replaced by equations
Local refutation not expanded (dependent voided, independent kept)
Old archive compatible (baseline profile still works)
offline_acceptance.full_execution_test: test_full_loop_choose_query_triggers_real_search_dispatch: choose(query)→search dispatch→read→interpret(supported)→answer_ready→choose(answer+refs)→submitted 'Ada Rowan'. Verifies text→fixture model output→state update→new task reaches underlying tool.

A.name: near-end mechanism
A.purpose: Verify the Interpret/Choose alternation and routing transitions on real model output near the end of a research episode.

B.name: one natural pairing
B.purpose: One natural question→task→judgment→action pairing under the real CPU index.

C.name: judge
C.purpose: Judge whether the submitted answer and cited evidence satisfy the constraint-state contract.

budget_rules.all_requests_count: All requests including format repairs count toward budget.
budget_rules.no_empty_ledger_reset: No empty ledger created to reset; historical 357/844 balances are not current.
budget_rules.no_key_switch_on_failure: No key/account/model switch on failure; tool refusals reported accurately, no channel switching.
budget_rules.authorized_config_only: Tested model and CPU index use existing authorized local config; base_url/keys not public.

promotion_criteria.offline_pass: All 19 offline tests pass and full suite regression-free (MET).
promotion_criteria.stage_a_pass: Interpret/Choose alternation observed on real model output; routing transitions match program reduction.
promotion_criteria.stage_b_pass: At least one full question→task→judgment→action→answer loop completes within budget.
promotion_criteria.stage_c_pass: Judge confirms cited evidence is delivered and quotes are exact.

security_constraints.no_credentials_uploaded: No credentials/keys/internal deployment/production index/full budget library uploaded.
security_constraints.base_url_from_local_config: base_url/keys from existing local config, not public.
security_constraints.tool_refusals_reported_accurately: Tool refusals reported accurately; no channel switching.
security_constraints.no_fabricated_online: Offline results not fabricated as online.
security_constraints.developer_reasoning_excluded: Claude Code reasoning/sub-agents/human knowledge must not enter the tested process.
